title: Boston Gas Company d/b/a KeySpan Energy Delivery files for review and approval by the Department of Telecommunications and Energy a Firm Gas Purchase and Sales Agreement with Brandeis University.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department Approves the proposed Agreement. The Department also finds that the pricing terms of the Agreement are competitively seneitive, and therefore grants the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Paul B. Vasington, Chairman; Commissioners w. Robert Keating, James Connelly, Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr., and Deirdre K. Manning. (GC 02-27)
